questions.question_bn: Particle rest থেকে 2 m/s²-এ 9 s accelerate করে, তারপর same speed-এ 3 s চলে। total distance কত m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Acceleration stage s₁=½at²=(9)², final v=2×(9)। uniform stage s₂=v·3=6×(9); total যোগ।

questions.question_bn: Convexlensf 10 cm gives real image 2timesobjectsize। object distance কত cm?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Real image|m|=v/u=2⇒v2u।1/f=1/u+1/(2u)=3/(2u)⇒u=1.5f。

questions.question_bn: Capacitors 10 μF ও 20 μF series, total 6 V। small capacitor voltage কত?

questions.question_bn: Block mass 6 kg,k=600 N/m;spring compression 0.2m। roughhorizontalμ0.2,g10। spring টি স্বাভাবিক দৈর্ঘ্যে ফিরলে block বিচ্ছিন্ন হয়। initial energy friction সহ stop হওয়া পর্যন্ত totaltravel কত m?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Initial spring energy½·100×(6)·0.04=2nJ। friction forceμmg=2nN, final rest/unstretched energy zero⇒s=E/f=1m। springblockdetacheswhenunstretchedassumed।

questions.question_bn: V(x)=6x²−6x volts। x=2 m-এ Ex কত V/m?

questions.question_bn: Identical 220 V heater resistance 6Ω। two series on 220 V; প্রতিটির power/একটি একা on220 V power কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। Series equal ভাগে each 110 V। P∝V² same R, ratio=(110/220)²=¼।

questions.question_bn: Two circular planets same orbital radius but central star mass M ও 9M। period ratio second/first কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। Newton–Kepler T=2π√(r³/(GM))। same r-এ T∝M⁻½, তাই ratio 1/√(9)।

questions.question_bn: Unpolarised I₀=48 W/m²। idealpolarisersaxes 0°,45°,90°। finalI কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। First transmit I₀/2=4×(6); next cos²45°½⇒2×(6);third relative 45°another½⇒(6)। crossedfirstlastdoesnotzeroaftermiddlepolariser।

questions.question_bn: Source frequency 3Hzapproachesstationaryreflectingwallatvsource=c/3। sourceandwallinair,receiver stationary behind source। reflected wave frequency কত Hz?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Wallstationaryhearsfwall=f c/(c−vs)=1.5×(3)। stationary reflection preserves wall frame frequency; receiver stationary also hears 1.5×(3)।

questions.question_bn: Stokesdragregime,sphere radius factor 2,viscosityfactor 7,density difference unchanged। terminal speed ratio কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 7। vterminal=2r²Δρg/(9η)। radius factor 2gives 4,viscosityn gives 1/(7)⇒ratio 4/(7)।

questions.question_bn: Carnot engine Th=500 K,Tc=250 K। efficiency কত %?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Carnot efficiency η=1−Tc/Th=1−½=½। Kelvin ratios, Celsius নয়।

questions.question_bn: M²⁺+2e⁻→M(s),25°C। ion concentration 10⁻11M। E−E° কত V?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। Q=1/[M²⁺]=10ⁿ, solidsactivity 1। Nernstshift−0.0592×(11)/2=−0.0296nV; dilution reduction potential কমায়।

questions.question_bn: 23 mol triglyceride complete NaOH saponification-এ NaOH কত mol লাগে?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 23। প্রতি triglyceride-এ 3ester linkage। each 1 mol NaOH hydrolyses; total 3×(23) mol, glycerol ও উৎপন্ন।

questions.question_bn: Gas collected over water total pressure 45k Pa, water vapour 2k Pa। dry gas partial pressure কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 25। Dalton total P=Pdry+Pwater। dry pressure=Ptotal−Pvapour=(25)+18k Pa; vapour pressure বাদ দিতে হয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ureasample 1740g। nitrogen mass কত g? CO(NH₂)₂,MW60
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 29। Eachureamolecule 2nitrogen atoms⇒28g Nper 60gurea। sample 60nghas 28ngN; mass fraction not atom fraction।

questions.question_bn: Acid ও alcohol 1:1 ester if i cation, limiting acid 10 mol, isolated yield 75%। ester mole কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Theoretical ester amount limiting acid (10) mol। actual 75%=0.75×(10)=3×(10)/4; excess alcohol yield multiplier নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: van der Waals gas n=3 mol,b=0.04L/mol,V=3L। available volume V−nb কত L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Excluded volume correction nb=0.04nL। available V−nb=(3)−0.04×(3)=0.96nL; attraction term আলাদা।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: 3molnon-electrolyte 500gwater-এ dissolve। molality কত mol/kg?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। Molality=moles/solventmasskg=(3)/0.5=2×(3)। solution volume বা solution mass denominator নয়।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: N₂+3H₂→2NH₃। initial N₂=9 mol,H₂=18 mol। maximumNH₃ কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 9। H₂limiting:reactionextent=(2×(9))/3,availableN₂(9) larger। NH₃=2extent=4×(9)/3 mol; balanced coefficients essential।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Impure CaCO₃sample excessHCl 12mmol reacts। leftoveracid needs NaOH 3mmol। CaCO₃ amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 3। HClconsumed=4×(3)−(3)=3nmmol। CaCO₃+2HCl uses 2acidpercarbonate; CaCO₃=1.5nmmol।
questions.subject: Chemistry

questions.question_bn: Ideal gas P2atm,V=73.80000000000001L,T300 K,R0.082। amount কত mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 6। (6)=PV/(RT)=2·12.3×(6)/(0.082·300)=24.6×(6)/24.6=(6) mol; no extra Avogadro multiplication।

questions.question_bn: 0.1M HCl 38 mL ও 0.1M NaOH 19 mL mix; additive volume। final[H⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 19। Initial H⁺0.2×(19) mmol, OH⁻0.1×(19) mmol; excess 0.1×(19) mmol,total 3×(19) mL। concentration 0.1/3=1/30M।

questions.question_bn: Cu²⁺+2e⁻→Cu। charge 4F passes,current efficiency 100%,MCu64। depositedmass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 4। nF=(4) mole electrons। cumoles=(4)/2, mass=((4)/2)·64=32ng; valency 2denominator।

questions.question_bn: 2800g brine 10%w/w Na Cl। solvent water mass কত g?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 28। 10%w/w means 100g solution-এ 10g Na Cl। salt 10×(28) g; remaining water 90×(28) g।

questions.question_bn: CH₄combustionreleases 890kJ/mol; amount 8 mol,burnerefficiency 80%। useful heat কত kJ?

questions.question_bn: Acyclic mono alkyne C10H18। total sigma-bond count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Carbon skeleton (10)−1sigma ও hydrogen 2×(10)−2sigma। total 3×(10)−3; triple bond contains oneσ andtwoπ।

questions.question_bn: Acyclic saturated hydrocarbon carbon count 10, C12,H1। molar mass কত g/mol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Alkane formulaCₙH₂ₙ₊₂। molar mass 12×(10)+2×(10)+2=14×(10)+2; alkene mass 14×(10) আলাদা।

questions.question_bn: Ag Cl Ksp=1×10⁻¹⁰। Na Cl solution [Cl⁻]=16×10⁻²M, Ag Cl saturated; s≪[Cl⁻]। [Ag⁺] কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 16। Ksp=[Ag⁺][Cl⁻]। common-ion approximation s=10⁻¹⁰/((16)×10⁻²)=(1/(16))×10⁻⁸M।

questions.question_bn: AcidicKMnO₄ 5mmol fullyoxidises Fe²⁺→Fe³⁺। Fe²⁺amount কত mmol?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। MnO₄⁻acidic Mn²⁺-এ 5electronaccepts। each Fe²⁺oneelectronloses⇒5Fe²⁺perpermanganate।

questions.question_bn: Equal volumes AgNO₃ ও Na Cl, each 5×10⁻⁴M। Ag Cl Ksp1×10⁻⁸। initial ionic product কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 5। Mixing doubles total volume, each ion concentration (5)×10⁻⁴/2। Qsp=((5)²/4)×10⁻⁸; তারপর Ksp তুলনা করে precipitation।

questions.question_bn: CaCO₃calcination 1tonnepurefeed; carbonateconversion 29%। emittedCO₂kg কত? MCaCO₃100,MCO₂44
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 29। Convertedmass 1000·(29)/100=10nkg CaCO₃। CO₂mass fraction 44/100⇒4.4nkg; combustionemissionexcluded।

questions.question_bn: Cu²⁺electrolysistheoreticalmass 50g,actual 40g। current efficiency কত %?

questions.question_bn: Acyclic hydrocarbon C19H38 with oneC=C, no ring। sigma-bond count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 19। C–C skeleton tree has (19)−1sigma, including double-bond oneσ। C–H bonds 2×(19)σ। total 3×(19)−1; πbond excluded।

questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 11। CaCO₃moles=(100×(11))/100=(11)। Ca Omoles 1:1×(11),mass 56ng; CO₂44ngsupports massbalance।

questions.question_bn: H-like ion Z=10, transition 3→2। photon energy/13.6eV কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 10। Energy difference Z²(1/2²−1/3²)=Z²(1/4−1/9)=5Z²/36। emission energy positive।

questions.question_bn: Two equal bond dipoles μ=11D make 120°। net dipole কত D?

questions.question_bn: Food oil iodometry-তে I₂ 9mmol মুক্ত। I₂+2S₂O₃²⁻→2I⁻+S₄O₆²⁻। thiosulfate কত mmol?

questions.question_bn: Weak monoprotic HA concentration 0.10M, Ka=169×10⁻⁸। x≪C। [H⁺] approx কত M?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 13। Ka≈x²/C⇒x=√(KaC)=√((13)²×10⁻⁹)=(13)×10⁻⁴⋅⁵। stated approximation check x/C ছোট থাকতে হবে।

questions.question_bn: A⇌B, initial[A]=17M,[B]=0। equilibrium[B]=1M। Kc কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 17। Stoichiometry 1:1-এ A decreases 1M। equilibrium[A]=(17)−1; Kc=[B]/[A]=1/((17)−1), initial concentration নয়।

questions.question_bn: Principal shell n=20। maximum orbital count কত?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 20। Shell includes l=0…(20)−1। orbital sum Σ(2l+1)=(20)²। electron capacity 2×(20)², orbitals নয়।

questions.question_bn: Gas volume 22L at300 K,1atm। final 600 K,4atm। final volume কত L?
questions.explanation: এই সমাধানে n = 22। Fixed gas amount combined law V₂/V₁=(T₂/T₁)(P₁/P₂)=2·¼=½। Celsius ব্যবহার নয়।
